auth.intro: A private, locally hosted assistant. Sign in through the development company identity provider.
auth.noPaidProvider: No paid AI provider is enabled in this POC.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

chat.deleteConfirm: “{title}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
chat.externalNotice: External model: messages in this conversation are sent to {provider} under that provider’s data terms. Free-tier providers may use them to improve their products — do not send confidential data.
chat.productCatalogExternal: Product catalog search sends your message to {provider} ({model}) to find matching products.
chat.stopped: Generation stopped. The partial response was preserved.
chat.emptyBody: Choose an available model and start a private conversation. {count} model(s) available.
chat.editPrompt: Edit and resend in a new branch
chat.feedbackPrompt: Optional feedback shared with administrators (chat text is not shared)
chat.sensitiveConfirm: Send this context to the external model anyway?
chat.connectionEnded: Connection ended before completion. Your saved response can be reopened.
chat.disclaimerSources: AI responses may be inaccurate. Verify answers and source excerpts.
chat.sources: Retrieved sources · verify against these excerpts
chat.usageLine: {input} in / {output} out · {duration} ms · {kind} · provider cost {cost} · charge {charge}
chat.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another account.
chat.titleRequired: Enter a name for the conversation.
chat.creditExhausted: Your organization's prepaid AI credit is used up. Ask an administrator to add credit.
chat.rateLimited: The usage limit for this model was reached. Wait a moment and try again.
chat.modelNotEntitled: This model is not included in your organization's plan.

usage.title: Usage dashboard
usage.intro: Actual, estimated, and simulated amounts are kept separate.
usage.simulatedProviderCostNote: Scenario only, e.g. a free-tier model at paid-tier list price; not payable
usage.historyNote: Latest 100 requests; prompt and response content are intentionally excluded.

admin.title: Platform operations
admin.intro: Aggregate metrics only. Private conversation content is never exposed here.
admin.pricingCreated: A new immutable pricing version was created.

knowledge.title: Product catalog (RAG)
knowledge.description: Import product data and index new or changed records for cited retrieval in chat.
knowledge.csvNote: CSV columns must match prisma/data/schema.sql; rows are upserted by product_id.
knowledge.imported: Imported {rows} rows ({created} new, {updated} updated). Index the catalog to make changes searchable.
knowledge.confirmTitle: Send product descriptions to an external embedding model?
knowledge.confirmExternal: This sends {count} product descriptions to {provider} ({model}) in approximately {requests} requests. The requests count toward external limits.
knowledge.started: Indexing {pending} products in {batches} requests; estimated time about {minutes} minute(s).
knowledge.removed: Removed {count} indexed passages for deleted products.
knowledge.upToDate: The product catalog is already up to date.
knowledge.runFailed: Indexing stopped after {embedded} of {pending} products: {error}. Saved batches remain searchable; index again to continue.
knowledge.runComplete: Embedded {embedded} products in {batches} requests; removed {removed} deleted passages.

filters.note: Filters apply to metrics, charts, and cost breakdown.

guard.title: External provider guardrail (today, UTC)
guard.description: Installation-wide ceiling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini. Requests beyond either limit are refused; local models are unaffected. Set via EXTERNAL_DAILY_REQUEST_LIMIT / EXTERNAL_DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT.

charts.perDayNote: All usage kinds in the selected range
charts.byProviderNote: Mock usage is synthetic; Ollama has $0 external API cost

snapshot.title: Cost and profitability snapshot
snapshot.note: Simulation is a planning view only; this POC creates no invoice and processes no payment.

breakdown.title: Cost breakdown by model
breakdown.note: Snapshots stored on each usage record; later pricing changes never alter these values.

registry.title: Model registry
registry.note: External models can be enabled only when ENABLE_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS=true and the server holds the provider credential. Availability reads gateway configuration and never calls a paid provider.
registry.notConfigured: Provider is not explicitly enabled and configured on the server

prices.title: Current model prices
prices.note: Latest version per model, USD per one million tokens. Select a row to edit.

pricing.title: Pricing management
pricing.note: Rates are per one million tokens. Saving always creates a new version.
pricing.previewNote: Preview compares clearly labeled actual and simulation results without saving anything.
pricing.currencyHint: Use a 3-letter currency code, e.g. USD.

permissions.title: User model permissions
permissions.note: An explicit choice overrides the model’s role defaults.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.note: Latest 100 model, permission, and pricing changes. Full before/after snapshots are stored in PostgreSQL.

workspace.title: Workspace controls
workspace.intro: Policies for every chat in this workspace. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

policy.title: External access & retention
policy.description: Pausing applies at once; the other settings apply when saved.
policy.paused: External providers paused; active streams stop within about 2 seconds
policy.resumed: External providers resumed; provider settings and quotas still apply
policy.note: Checks cover outgoing history, instructions, memories and retrieved excerpts; pattern detection is best-effort. Retention permanently removes message text, citations and feedback from inactive chats, including deleted ones, in hourly batches; usage totals remain. Project documents and memories are managed separately.
policy.retentionConfirm: Content of chats inactive for more than {days} days will be permanently removed in the hourly sweep.
policy.previewResult: {count} chats are eligible under the saved {days}-day policy.

quotas.title: Quotas & simulated budgets
quotas.note: Daily limits in UTC; blank is unlimited, 0 blocks. Every matching quota applies, and role, model and department quotas are shared by everyone in them. Requests in progress reserve an estimate of their input plus the maximum output. Budgets use the simulated provider cost in USD and charge nothing.
quotas.subject: Applies to
quotas.subjectRequired: Choose who this quota applies to

departments.title: Departments
departments.note: Reports and quotas use each user's current department. A change saves when you leave the field.

templates.title: Prompt templates & personas
templates.note: Saved instructions people can start a chat with. Every save is recorded in the audit log.
templates.name: Name
templates.modelsHint: None selected means every model the user may use. The server also caps output tokens.

feedback.title: Response feedback
feedback.note: Comments people chose to send to administrators. Chat prompts and answers are not included.

credit.title: Prepaid AI credit
credit.description: Every AI request, local mock included, is charged to this credit at the platform price list. New requests are refused once it runs out.
credit.unavailable: The platform gateway cannot be reached right now.
credit.exhausted: Credit is used up: AI requests are refused until the platform adds credit.

settings.title: Account & deployment
settings.themeNote: Light, dark, or follow your device.
settings.routing: Every request routes through NestJS and LiteLLM. The default model is the local deterministic mock; Ollama and external providers stay disabled until an administrator explicitly enables them.
settings.resources: Local services still consume CPU, memory, disk, and electricity.
settings.privacyBody: Conversation ownership is enforced by the backend from the validated token subject. Administrators receive aggregate usage data, not private chat content. Full prompts and responses are not logged by default.
settings.sessionBody: Authentication uses Keycloak Authorization Code Flow with PKCE. Use Logout in the sidebar to end the identity-provider session.

liveUsage.title: Token usage in real time
liveUsage.intro: Completed usage refreshes automatically. In-flight reservations are shown separately until the response settles.
liveUsage.reservationNote: Reservations protect quotas while generation is running. They are removed and replaced by actual, estimated, or synthetic usage when the request finishes.
liveUsage.recentNote: Latest completed requests · input and output stacked
liveUsage.feedNote: No prompt or response content is shown here
liveUsage.feedEmpty: Send a chat message to see token activity.
